title: [BUG] Exported Dictionary with element type type hint not displayed correctly in the inspector
body: ### Tested versions - Reproducible in Godot Engine v4.5.stable.mono.official [876b29033] ### System information Godot v4.5.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6094) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.94 GiB memory ### Issue description Exported dictionary with type hint `DictionaryType` (38) and hint string for element types is not displayed correctly in the editor. ```cs property["hint"] = (long) PropertyHint.DictionaryType; property["hint_string"] = $"String;String/{PropertyHint.Enum:D}:Option1,Option2,Option3"; ``` Even though the hint string defines the value element type to String (as shown above), the "New Value" field shows as null in the inspector. Now, if I manually set the type of the "New Value" field to String using the pencil button, then the inspector correctly recognizes the Enum type hint: An additional observation I found is: When I inspect a node that already has entries in the dictionary, the value fields of these items are correctly shown as enums, as per the hint string. Only the "New Value" field is not correct. In the picture below, the items already in the dictionary are Enums, but the "New Value" field is null. Another notable behavior is: If I simplify the hint string of the dictionary to have only simple types without type hint, then the "New Value" field is shown correctly. (see below) ```cs property["hint"] = (long) PropertyHint.DictionaryType; // Simplified hint string; no Enum hint type for the dictionary elements property["hint_string"] = "String;String"; ``` With the simplified hint string, the "New Value" field is shown correctly: ### Steps to reproduce - Create a new script extending Node - Add an exported Dictionary - Set its type hint to 32 (`DictionaryType`) and hint string to `"String;String/2:Option1,Option2,Option3"` - Inspect the node in the editor Expected Behavior: The keys of the dictionary are strings and the values are a dropdown enum field with 3 value options. Actual Behavior: The "New Key" field is correct, but the "New Value" is null. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
